question: Which winds are also known by the name of ‘Roaring Forties’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Westerly **____**winds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Westerly **Winds:

 
 
• The easterlies from either side of the equator converge in the **Inter Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ).**
 
• Such circulations from the surface upwards and vice-versa are called cells.
 
• In the middle latitudes, the circulation is that of sinkin
